HS:41 strains by htAFLP

In South Africa, serotype HS:41 is over-represented among GRS-associated strains [10]. Previous studies have shown that TIS:41 strains, both GBS-associated and controls, are highly clonal 12]. As expected, htAFLP of six CBS-associated, one MIS-associated and six control HS:41 strains generated very homogeneous banding patterns (results not shown).
